list.caption: Equipment list. Click a column header to sort.
list.sortHint: Click to sort, click again to reverse
list.loadFailed: Could not load the equipment list. Please try again.
list.searchWithAttributes: Search (name, model, serial number, common name, short/long-text extra attributes)

detail.title: Equipment details
detail.conflictReload: Someone else saved first, so the latest data was reloaded. Please edit again.
detail.disposedNote: This equipment is disposed. In the list, choose 'Disposed' in the status filter to see it.
detail.inWorkNote: This equipment is in a work plan or a plan under approval, so it cannot be disposed of or moved to another department.
detail.attributeLoss: Moving the managing department removes {n} extra attribute value(s) of the original department. Move it?
detail.disposeConfirm: The status changes to 'Disposed'. Disposed equipment cannot be chosen in work plans. Save?

edit.help: Edit directly in the table. Each row is saved when you move to another row or finish editing. Press Esc to undo the changes in that row. Software, network, carry-out and current location are edited on the details page.
edit.conflict: Someone else saved first, so the row was reloaded. Please edit again.
edit.forbidden: Your permission to edit some equipment changed, so the list was reloaded. Changes to that equipment were not saved.
edit.failedOnPages: Some rows on page {pages} could not be saved.
edit.attributeLoss: {name}: moving the managing department removes {n} extra attribute value(s) of the original department. Move it?
edit.departmentKept: The managing department was kept. If you changed other cells, save again.
edit.disposeConfirm: {name}: the status changes to 'Disposed'. Disposed equipment cannot be chosen in work plans. Save?
edit.statusKept: The status was not changed to Disposed. If you changed other cells, save again.

carryOut.title: Change carry-out
carryOut.help: Record equipment taken out without work (lent to another department, outside repair, etc.). Reserved and work carry-outs are set by work plans.
carryOut.reasonHint: Why you are changing it (required, up to 200 characters).
carryOut.byWorkNote: Set by a work plan, so it cannot be changed until the work ends.
carryOut.inWorkNote: This equipment is in a work plan or a plan under approval, so it cannot be marked as out.
carryOut.departmentInvalid: Check the department it went to.

import.title: Bulk upload (Excel)
import.help: Fill in the template or edit a downloaded list and upload it. If any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
import.result: Registered {created}, updated {updated}, unchanged {unchanged}, skipped {skipped} rows (departments you cannot manage)
import.attributeCleared: {n} row(s) moved department and had original extra attribute values removed.

materials.photoHelp: One PNG or JPG file, up to 5 MB. Replacing removes the previous photo. Diagram boxes that loaded this photo always show the current one.
materials.photoDeleteConfirm: Delete the equipment photo? It also disappears from diagram boxes.
materials.photoTooLarge: Not uploaded: the file is larger than 5 MB.
materials.photoType: Only PNG or JPG images can be uploaded.
materials.filesHelp: Documents and images only (PDF, HWP, Word/Excel/PowerPoint, text, PNG/JPG), up to 10 MB per file. No limit on the number of files. People who can edit this equipment upload and delete them (including files uploaded by others).
materials.alreadyGone: Already deleted. The list has been reloaded.
materials.loadFailed: Could not load the equipment photo and related files.

errors.EQUIPMENT_SERIAL_DUPLICATE: Equipment with the same model and serial number already exists.
errors.EQUIPMENT_MAC_DUPLICATE: Equipment with the same MAC address already exists.
errors.EQUIPMENT_EDIT_CONFLICT: Someone else saved first. Reload and edit again.
errors.EQUIPMENT_CARRY_OUT_BY_WORK: This equipment is tied to a work plan, so its carry-out cannot be changed.
errors.LOCATION_REQUIRED: When carried out, enter the department or place.
errors.PLACE_INVALID: Place must be 100 characters or fewer.
errors.EQUIPMENT_IN_USE: Equipment in a work plan or a plan under approval cannot be disposed of or moved.
errors.EQUIPMENT_DEPARTMENT_DELETED: Its department was deleted. Move it to an active department before restoring it.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Files up to 6MB can be uploaded.
errors.STATUS_SCOPE_DENIED: A department you cannot view is included.
errors.DATA_CONFLICT: Conflicted with another request. Reload and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Could not process the request. Please try again later.
errors.ATTRIBUTE_NOT_OF_DEPARTMENT: Not an extra attribute of the equipment's managing department.
errors.FILE_NOT_TEMP: Some files are too old or cannot be used. Remove them and upload again.
